question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)

calls.reasoning: Resolves on Apple's FQ4 2026 (quarter ending Sept 26, 2026) revenue, reported Nov 2. Guidance: +9-11% YoY on $102.5B = $111.7-113.7B, with a 2.5pt FX headwind and heavier supply constraints. Recent track record: Q4FY25 landed at the bottom of guidance (8% vs 8-10%), Q3FY26 mid-range (16% vs 14-17%), Q1FY26 a big beat (16% vs 10-12%). Supply-constrained quarters cap the upside. Consensus is ~$113.6B (27 analysts, range 112.25-117.2B), slightly above the top of guidance. Median ~$113.5B; ~12% chance of landing below $112B (bottom-of-range miss). No Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker market found.
calls.dossier:
- Target: Apple fiscal Q4 2026 revenue (quarter Jun 28-Sep 26, 2026). Apple reports Nov 2, 2026, 1:30pm PT (MacRumors, Oct 6 2026). New CEO John Ternus, CFO Kevan Parekh.
- Resolves off Apple's reported total net sales for that quarter, not segment figures or consensus.
- Event window: quarter ended Sep 26 2026 -> number published Nov 2 2026; as of Oct 7 the quarter is over and the number is not yet public.
- Year-ago (Q4 FY25) revenue: $102.5B (MacRumors).
- Guidance (Jul 30 2026 call): total revenue +9 to 11% YoY = ~$111.7-113.7B; FX sequential headwind ~2.5pt; significantly greater supply constraints on iPhone, Mac, iPad; iPhone growth mid-teens; GM 47-48% (MacRumors; TechTimes Jul 31 2026).
- At the time of the call, sell-side had expected ~12% growth; the guide was below that (TechTimes).
- Yahoo Finance analyst page (Oct 2026): current-quarter consensus ~$113.6B from 27 analysts, low ~$112.25B, high ~$117.2B.
- Track record vs guidance: Q3 FY26 guided 14-17%, actual 16% ($109.4B) (TidBITS/9to5Mac); Q1 FY26 guided ~10-12%, actual ~16% ($143.8B) (background); Q4 FY25 guided 8-10%, actual ~8% (background).
- Q3 FY26 detail: iPhone $54.3B +22%, Mac $10.4B +29% despite constraints, Services $30.7B +12% (missed estimates) (9to5Mac Jul 30 2026).
- Quarter includes ~1 week of iPhone 18 Pro launch sales, plus Watch Series 12/Ultra 4 and AirPods 5; iPhone Duo launched Oct 23 (next quarter) (MacRumors).
- Memory cost/supply crunch ('RAMageddon') is limiting unit supply (TidBITS May 2026).
- Markets: no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker market found.
- Searched, not found: post-quarter preannouncement; fresh September sell-through data.

calls.reasoning: Apple guided fiscal Q4 2026 (September quarter) to +9-11% YoY on $102.47B, i.e. $111.7-113.7B with a $112.7B midpoint. That guide assumed a 2.5pt FX headwind and significantly worse supply constraints; iPhone is guided to grow mid-teens. Over the last three quarters actuals beat the guidance midpoint by ~0.8-5pp (16% vs a 10-12% guide; 17% in the March quarter; 16.3% vs a 14-17% guide). In fiscal Q4 2025 Apple landed at the bottom of its range. Supply constraints limit the upside, but strong demand and the ~12% Street consensus support a modest beat, so the median is ~11.1% growth (~$113.9B). No Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi market was found. Results are due 2 Nov 2026.

calls.reconciliation: Disputes: (1) the consensus level was quoted as $113.6B (Yahoo, 27 analysts, Oct), ~$114.3B (at guidance time) and $115.06B (tradingpedia, unclear provenance). I couldn't verify these without web access. I weighted the dated Oct Yahoo figure most and treated $115.06B as likely stale. (2) Weight on the Sep 2025 bottom-of-range outcome vs the recent beats: this is judgment. Supply constraints cap the upside, but Apple guides conservatively. I took a median slightly above the guide top and a ~7% chance below $112B, between Run 2's 4% and Run 1's 12%, because Apple has rarely missed the bottom of its guide recently. I carried forward the runs' reference class and a similar dispersion.
